title: Etale and Zariski cohomology of quasi-coherent modules agree, naturally in the module
statement:
Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $X_{\Et}$ its small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site]. For a quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module $\mathcal F$ [pqf-def-coherent] let $\mathcal F_{\mathrm{et}}\in\Ab(X_{\Et})$ [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves] be the associated etale sheaf $u\mapsto\Gamma(U,u^*\mathcal F)$ of [def-sc-etale-qcoherent-module], and for an $\mathcal O_X$-linear morphism $\varphi:\mathcal F\to\mathcal G$ of quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] let $\varphi_{\mathrm{et}}:\mathcal F_{\mathrm{et}}\to\mathcal G_{\mathrm{et}}$ be given on an object $u:U\to X$ of $X_{\Et}$ by $\Gamma(U,u^*\varphi):\Gamma(U,u^*\mathcal F)\to\Gamma(U,u^*\mathcal G)$, where $u^*$ is the pullback of modules [def-pc-module-pullback]. Then $\varphi_{\mathrm{et}}$ is a morphism of $\Ab(X_{\Et})$, and there are isomorphisms of abelian groups
$$
c^q_{\mathcal F}:H^q(X,\mathcal F)\xrightarrow{\ \sim\ }H^q(X_{\Et},\mathcal F_{\mathrm{et}})\qquad(q\geq0),
$$
the left side the cohomology of $\mathcal F$ on $X$ [pqf-def-cohomology], the right side etale cohomology [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology], with $c^0_{\mathcal F}$ the identity of $\Gamma(X,\mathcal F)$, such that for every $\mathcal O_X$-linear $\varphi:\mathcal F\to\mathcal G$ of quasi-coherent modules and every $q\geq0$
$$
c^q_{\mathcal G}\circ H^q(X,\varphi)=H^q(X_{\Et},\varphi_{\mathrm{et}})\circ c^q_{\mathcal F}.
$$
